title: Migrate feed scrolling, refresh and explicit routes
description: Use CupertinoSliverRefreshControl for iOS feed refresh and RefreshIndicator for Android; do not use RefreshIndicator.adaptive because it leaves the Material interaction structure. Let each selected app root provide scrolling physics instead of hardcoding BouncingScrollPhysics or ClampingScrollPhysics in features. Integrate the feed with PrimaryScrollController so iOS status-bar tap-to-top works while pagination, stable scroll identity, and programmatic feed scroll-to-top continue to work. Route the existing full-screen media viewer with CupertinoPageRoute on iOS and MaterialPageRoute on Android.
design: Use built-in native routes and transitions rather than custom transition implementations. Preserve iOS interactive swipe-back and Android system/predictive back. Keep refresh, pagination, filters, cache provenance, and repository/Bloc responsibilities unchanged.

On Android, the feed uses RefreshIndicator, Material root scrolling behavior, and MaterialPageRoute with system/predictive back. No feature hardcodes platform scroll physics and RefreshIndicator.adaptive is not used as a substitute for the iOS sliver interaction. Scroll position and post identity remain stable across refresh and state changes; pagination does not duplicate requests. Route, refresh, back, and scrolling tests use stable keys/semantics/user actions, with concrete component assertions confined to platform-boundary tests.
notes: Implemented native feed mechanics: iOS inserts CupertinoSliverRefreshControl into the feed slivers; Android wraps the same CustomScrollView in RefreshIndicator. AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics only enables short-feed refresh and composes with the selected app root's platform physics; no BouncingScrollPhysics or ClampingScrollPhysics is hardcoded. Dashboard owns and provides the feed ScrollController above AppScaffold via PrimaryScrollController, allowing CupertinoPageScaffold status-bar tap-to-top while existing programmatic top, pagination, and filter reset use the same controller. Full-screen property media selects CupertinoPageRoute on iOS and MaterialPageRoute elsewhere. Environment: emulator-5554 (Medium Phone API 35), Apple M1 Pro host GPU (Metal GLES/Vulkan translator), 60Hz vsync, default resolution, hosted API.

3. Present timestamps: `adb shell dumpsys SurfaceFlinger --latency 'SurfaceView[...MainActivity](BLAST)#<id>'` — deltas of actual-present column = frame times.
4. Perfetto system trace (16s: sched + view/gfx/input/am + surfaceflinger.frametimeline), pulled, analyzed with trace_processor v58.2. Trace kept at `android/captures/profile-scroll-trace.perfetto`.

- Profile build: frames=125-433 across windows; p50 16.8-33.0ms, p90 33.0-83.3ms, p99 up to ~525ms, max ~929ms; >33ms = 37-45%.
- Release build (same method, same session): frames=125; p50=31.3ms, p90=67.1ms, p95=95.4ms, p99=99.1ms, max=146.7ms; >33ms = 36.8%.

- `1.raster` thread: 529 runs / 2691ms CPU, worst single run 109.5ms. Top slices are emulator GLES-bridge encodes, not Flutter draw work: `glGenRenderbuffers encode` 1156.0ms, `glEnable encode` 463.3ms, `glDepthFunc encode` 293.8ms, `eglSwapBuffers` 143-194ms.

title: Polish Android feed press feedback
description: Android touch feedback is visibly inconsistent: the post header feels correct, while post engagement actions and the View comments surface feel broad or hacky; bottom navigation is acceptable but should be more restrained. Preserve the all-around successful iOS press-opacity behavior and existing visual/hit geometry.
acceptance_criteria: On Android, engagement, comments preview, and dashboard navigation use contained, restrained overlays with deliberate shapes; no splash leaks across neighboring content; visible geometry, 48px targets, semantics, and actions remain unchanged. iOS continues to use its existing Cupertino press-opacity behavior. Focused app_ui/mobile tests and analysis pass.
notes: Owner device review after the first pass: engagement icon buttons remained excellent; comments preview improved; Stories/status and navigation appeared worse with a double response. Revised implementation centralizes the quiet ripple and transparent duplicate highlight in AppTheme, contains Story ink to the 66px image while retaining the whole item action, and contains navigation ink to a 48px circle centered on its 24px icon. Owner then found the navigation ripple clipped at the top; the navigation now reserves the full non-negative 48px ink box in normal layout while preserving the 24px icon position, 11px label gap, and overall bar height. iOS remains on Cupertino opacity. title: Align post edge actions and divider spacing
description: The feed row currently shifts an uncounted bookmark farther right than the post overflow action, and the final post content sits too close to the divider. Use one shared right-edge target inset for equivalent icon actions and add a small explicit gap before the divider without shrinking accessible targets.
design: Figma post nodes [private design node removed] and [private design node removed] place both right-edge glyphs against the same 20px visual inset and use 12px outer vertical padding. Keep the existing exact SVGs and centered 48px AppIconButton targets; compensate their 16px side slack once in the PostCard parent, and add an 8px bottom gap as the smallest existing spacing token that visibly improves separation without approximating a new global value.
acceptance_criteria: At 428px and 360px widths, the icon-only overflow and bookmark glyphs share the same horizontal center and visible right edge; bookmark toggling does not move its target; every post reserves an explicit 8px in-flow gap between its final content target and divider; 48px action targets remain intact; focused tests and analysis pass.
notes: Implemented in PostCard with one shared compensated edge-action inset: the overflow target now occupies the same right edge as the icon-only bookmark target while both keep centered 48x48 controls and exact 16x16 committed SVGs. Added an explicit AppSpacing.small (8 logical px) gap before every post divider. Evidence on macOS with the host Flutter toolchain: flutter test test/feed/post_card_test.dart passed 18 tests; flutter analyze passed with no issues; full flutter test passed 168 tests; git diff --check passed. Widget assertions cover aligned overflow/bookmark glyph centers at 428 and 360 logical px, equal target right edges, retained 48px targets, and the exact 8px divider gap. Figma design context from nodes [private design node removed] and [private design node removed] confirms the shared 20px visible right edge; no fresh device screenshot or overlay was produced in this change.
close_reason: Aligned the post overflow and icon-only bookmark controls through one parent edge inset, added the requested divider spacing, and passed focused/full Flutter verification.

title: Keep engagement button content centered
description: The counted-bookmark test drove a trailing content alignment that the owner rejects as a poorer interaction experience. Restore centered AppIconButton content on every platform, remove the over-specific counted-edge test and alignment API, and retain the independent liker-preview fix.
acceptance_criteria: All AppIconButton content remains centered in its accessible target; the counted bookmark optical-edge test and alignment override are removed; liker-preview behavior remains covered; app_ui and mobile analysis/tests pass.
notes: Restored centered AppIconButton behavior on both native control families, removed the public alignment option and its package test, reverted the counted-bookmark inset compensation, and deleted the counted optical-edge widget test. Retained the liker-preview behavior and its tests. Verification on macOS: packages/app_ui flutter test passed 37 and flutter analyze passed; apps/expert_listing_mobile flutter test passed 168 and flutter analyze passed; git diff --check passed. Owner decision remains: do not off-align button content to satisfy optical edge assertions.

Figma frame [private design node removed] confirmed the trailing visual edge contract. title: Correct create-post prompt visual alignment
description: The create-post prompt differs from the canonical feed reference: its hint color, button-to-avatar leading space, avatar border, and horizontal alignment relative to the following post are incorrect. Correct the prompt while preserving the active preview actor and accessible press target.
acceptance_criteria: At 428 logical pixels, the prompt text uses the required semantic color, its bordered avatar has the corrected space from the pill leading edge, the pill begins outside the post avatar edge, and the prompt avatar aligns with the following post avatar. Focused geometry/style tests, formatting, analysis, and diff checks pass.
notes: Implemented the owner-corrected create-post prompt contract: tertiary hint color, 12px pill inset, 8px leading pad, 20px prompt/post avatar alignment, and a 1px semantic circular avatar border without changing the 40px visual box. Evidence on macOS with the repository Flutter SDK: dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed passed for both changed Dart files; flutter analyze passed clean; flutter test test/feed/create_post_prompt_test.dart test/feed/feed_view_test.dart passed 36 tests; git diff --check passed. No new device screenshot or manual overlay was performed.

title: Keep liker preview stable during like toggles
description: Like and unlike optimistically clear likePreview, causing the Liked by row to disappear until refresh and remain absent after a failed mutation. Preserve truthful preview data while counts and current-user state update, while still hiding the row when the confirmed count reaches zero.
acceptance_criteria: For posts with existing liker preview data, liking preserves the preview and unliking removes only the active user's preview entry; other confirmed liker images do not transiently disappear. A failed mutation restores the prior engagement state including the full preview; a positive count without identities keeps a truthful generic row; zero-like posts hide it; focused tests pass.
notes: Implemented stable liker previews: optimistic likes retain known liker identities; optimistic unlikes remove only the active preview actor; successful reconciliation preserves safe in-memory preview state until refresh; failed mutations restore the full confirmed preview; positive counts without identities render a truthful generic summary. Evidence on macOS with Flutter SDK in the repository environment: flutter analyze passed; flutter test test/feed/feed_bloc_test.dart passed 18 tests; flutter test test/feed/feed_view_test.dart passed 32 tests; flutter test test/feed/post_card_test.dart --plain-name liker passed 2 tests; git diff --check passed. The complete post_card_test.dart file still has its unrelated counted bookmark alignment assertion miss by 0.078 logical pixels; reproduced unchanged at detached HEAD cb41700, so it was not altered as part of this bug.
close_reason: Fixed optimistic liker preview flicker and verified focused behavior.

title: Make branded typography tracking platform-independent
description: Open Runde roles leave letterSpacing unset, allowing Cupertino and Material DefaultTextStyle tracking to produce platform differences. Apply the Figma tracking values to every observed branded role and explicit neutral tracking to app-defined roles without a Figma counterpart, then verify effective rendering under both native roots.
acceptance_criteria: Every AppTypography role declares an explicit tracking value; observed Figma roles use their exact percentage-to-pixel value and app-defined roles use documented neutral tracking; every role has matching effective letter spacing under iOS and Android roots; focused app_ui/mobile tests and analysis pass.
close_reason: Completed the full typography correction. Every AppTypography role now requires explicit tracking: Figma-observed 12/400, 13/400, 13/500, 14/400, and 16/500 roles use -0.6% converted by size; observed 14/500 and app-defined 14/600 and 20/600 roles use neutral tracking. Render-level tests cover all 12 roles under iOS and Android roots. app_ui test passed 36 tests, mobile story-strip test passed, both analyzers were clean, and git diff --check passed.

title: Prevent Android image preview distortion
description: Opening a property image on Android stretches the bitmap despite the full-screen viewer using BoxFit.contain. Preserve the source aspect ratio through decode and display, add focused regression coverage, and verify the affected Flutter surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Full-screen property imagery retains its source aspect ratio on Android without changing feed thumbnail cropping; focused tests prove the preview decode/display contract and analysis passes.
notes: Root cause: AppNetworkImage supplied both screen-width and screen-height memCache dimensions. CachedNetworkImage 4.0.0 passes these through OctoImage to Flutter ResizeImage; the exact resize policy independently clamps both axes and can turn a landscape source into a portrait decoded bitmap before BoxFit.contain. Fixed contained images by supplying only memCacheWidth so Flutter derives decoded height from the source aspect ratio. Feed BoxFit.cover behavior is unchanged. Verification on macOS with Flutter 3.47.0/Dart 3.13.0: packages/app_ui flutter test test/app_ui_test.dart passed 35 tests; packages/app_ui flutter analyze clean; apps/expert_listing_mobile flutter test test/feed/post_card_test.dart passed 16 tests; apps/expert_listing_mobile flutter test passed 163 tests; apps/expert_listing_mobile flutter analyze clean; dart format changed no files; git diff --check clean. The initial parallel mobile focused-test attempt collided with Flutters startup lock and failed during ephemeral package cleanup; the immediate isolated rerun passed. A fresh named-device visual screenshot was not captured in this change.
close_reason: Prevented exact two-axis decoding in contained full-screen images, retained feed thumbnail cropping, and added passing decode regression coverage.

title: Ding for foreground activity notifications
description: Add foreground-only local notification delivery for newly detected server-backed activity. Poll only while the app is resumed, establish a silent actor-scoped baseline, request platform notification permission, and avoid duplicate alerts across refreshes and persona switches.
acceptance_criteria: While the app is resumed, a newly created unread activity event is detected within the documented bounded polling interval and produces one native local notification with sound when permission is granted. Existing activity at startup does not alert; already-seen IDs, read events, overlapping polls, app pause, and persona changes do not leak or duplicate alerts. Android and iOS setup compiles, behavior remains useful when permission is denied, and focused/full verification passes.
notes: Implemented foreground-only local activity alerts with flutter_local_notifications 22.3.0, resumed-only 30-second polling, silent baseline, per-preview-actor persisted cursors, unread oldest-first delivery, lifecycle/race protection, Android resources/permission, and iOS foreground delegate. Evidence: flutter analyze clean; flutter test 153 passed; debug APK and iOS simulator builds passed; Android 15 native-boundary journey passed against local Hono/Postgres. Cold-booted iPhone 16 Pro build passed, but the journey encountered the real iOS notification authorization boundary: simctl cannot pre-grant notifications and current simulator authorization is denied, so one manual Allow Notifications action remains before the audible iOS check. No hosted deployment performed.

description: The full-screen property preview currently opens only the tapped image. Present all ordered property images in one swipeable full-screen viewer, starting at the tapped image, while preserving zoom, semantics, native route behavior, and stable black system surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Opening any property image starts the full-screen viewer at that image; one-finger horizontal swipes move through all ordered images; each page exposes its correct photo position semantic label; iOS interactive route back, Android system back, and black system-bar treatment remain intact; focused widget coverage passes. description: Replace the List create-post action with a genuine property catalog. Present property posts as property-first cards with ordered imagery leading and concise property details below, while retaining truthful pagination, retry, empty, and image behavior.

acceptance_criteria: List selects and preserves its own destination state, loads only property posts, paginates without duplicate requests, and never mutates Feed filters or scroll state. Listing cards lead with stable image geometry and show status, location, and concise description below; tapping a card shows the agreed property-detail preview boundary. Loading, failure, empty, and dark-mode states work at 360px and 428px widths.

title: Build premium autocomplete search
description: Replace the Search boundary notice with a genuine destination: a focused search field, server-backed autocomplete cards, bounded persisted recent searches when present, and a few deliberate quick searches only when they shorten common property discovery. Selecting an autocomplete card records the query and shows the exact property-detail preview boundary.
design: Prefer a location/property autocomplete contract over broad full-text discovery unless Prince chooses otherwise. Use existing Dio, Riverpod lifecycle ownership, Bloc overlap handling, shared_preferences, app_ui controls, and server-built media URLs; add no search package or local database.
acceptance_criteria: Typing issues bounded debounced search requests and stale responses cannot replace a newer query. Empty, loading, no-result, failure, recent, and suggestion states are deliberate in light/dark mode at 360px and 428px widths. Recent searches survive provider reconstruction, are bounded, removable/clearable, and never imply server sync. Activating a suggestion produces a non-stacking exact boundary notice and no fake details route.
notes: Reopened after review: fix recent-search event ordering and live status semantics, then rerun mobile verification.
close_reason: Verified bounded 3-120 character autocomplete, stale-response protection, serialized local recents, distinguishing property semantics, large-text growth, and truthful boundaries. Evidence: mobile flutter analyze clean; flutter test 103 passed; scripts/run-api-tests 31 passed across guarded modes; local pgTAP 83 passed; discovery_journey_test passed on iPhone 16 Pro iOS 18.0 and Android 15 API 35 against local Hono/Postgres/preferences.

title: Add server-backed activity notifications
description: Replace the Notification boundary notice with an activity destination backed by Hono and Postgres, beginning with another user liking a post authored by the server-resolved current user. Define durable-versus-derived notification semantics before the migration.
design: Build after desired-state likes are real. Use a thin Hono route and vetted security-definer database function. Derive from likes if notifications may disappear on unlike; add a notification-events table only if durable history or read state is approved.
acceptance_criteria: The notification API returns only activity addressed to the request's server-resolved actor, excludes self-like noise, orders deterministically, uses safe DTOs and no raw client user ID, and exposes honest loading, empty, retry, and light/dark UI states. A real database/API journey proves another user can like the current user's post and the activity appears. Read/unread or unlike-history behavior matches the approved decision.
notes:
Owner decision, 2026-09-05: like notifications are durable activity history and remain after unlike. Add a notification-events table and read state rather than deriving the inbox from current likes.
Implemented durable server-backed like notifications with atomic event creation, recipient-scoped list/read RPCs and Hono routes, deterministic seeds, Flutter DTO/repository/Riverbloc state, lazy dashboard UI, retry/refresh/read handling, light/dark coverage, and specification/wiki updates. Verification on 2026-09-05: direnv exec . scripts/run-api-tests => 40 passed, 0 failed; direnv exec . supabase test db --local => 161 passed; direnv exec . supabase db lint --local --level warning => no schema errors; direnv exec . deno fmt --check src tests and deno lint src tests => 21 files checked each; direnv exec . deno check src/app.ts tests/notifications_test.ts => passed; direnv exec . flutter analyze => no issues; direnv exec . flutter test => 147 passed; discovery_journey_test.dart passed against local Hono/Postgres/preferences on Android 15 API 35 emulator using 10.0.2.2:56321 and on a cold-restarted iPhone 16 Pro iOS 18 simulator using 127.0.0.1:56321. The journey proves Bizzaro likes Prince's post, Prince receives and reads the event, and the same read event remains after unlike; cleanup restores Bizzaro's like to false. Hosted migration/function deployment and hosted verification remain unperformed because no deployment authorization was given.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria verified locally on Android and iOS with durable, isolated, readable like activity; hosted deployment remains intentionally unperformed.

title: Build profile and safe preview user switching
description: Replace the Profile boundary notice with server-backed current-user details and a debug-only developer tool for switching among deterministic preview personas. Preserve system-controlled light/dark appearance rather than adding an in-app theme selector.
design: Add a request-scoped, server-gated preview alias mapped server-side to known fixture users; retain CURRENT_USER_ID as the default. Riverpod owns the actor context and dependent lifecycle. Do not use process-global mutable server state, production impersonation, full authentication, or a theme selector.
acceptance_criteria: Profile loads the server-resolved user's display name, handle, role, and avatar with deliberate loading/failure states and system light/dark styling. Debug builds may show a current-user switch only when the backend explicitly allows preview actors; production hides it and the server rejects overrides. The client never submits a raw user UUID. Switching actor resets/reloads feed, listing, search-sensitive, profile, and notification state so no prior actor data leaks.
notes:
Owner decision, 2026-09-05: current-user switching is local-debug-only. It is hidden in release builds and requires an explicit local backend opt-in; hosted preview and production do not accept it. Profile follows system light/dark appearance and adds no theme selector.
Implemented locally 2026-09-05: GET /profile via service-role-only user_profile RPC; request-scoped X-Preview-Actor aliases; exact local URL plus ALLOW_PREVIEW_ACTORS=true gate; hosted/lookalike rejection; Profile loading/failure/retry UI; debug-only selector; Riverpod recreation of Dio, feed/listings/search/profile lifecycles; actor-namespaced saved feed data; no client UUIDs; system theme retained. Evidence: flutter analyze clean; Flutter unit/widget/integration suite 102/102; app_ui 33/33; pgTAP 83/83; API 31/31 across disabled and enabled modes; Android 15 API 35 real-stack discovery/Profile journey passed; live local GET /profile returned Prince fixture. Remaining: hosted migration/function deployment and hosted Profile smoke require explicit deployment authorization; iOS device execution remains blocked by the existing Flutter log-reader failure.
Evidence wording correction: 102/102 is the apps/expert_listing_mobile unit/widget suite; the Android integration journey is the separate passing test recorded immediately afterward.
Release APK build was attempted with the approved hosted API URL and stopped at the intentional signing gate because android/key.properties is not configured; no signing files or secrets were added. Release-mode artifact execution therefore remains unverified.
close_reason: Complete and verified. Implemented GET /profile through service-role-only user_profile RPC; request-scoped X-Preview-Actor aliases gated by exact local Supabase host plus ALLOW_PREVIEW_ACTORS=true; hosted/lookalike rejection; no client or response UUIDs; Profile loading/failure/retry and system light/dark UI; debug-only selector; Riverpod recreation of actor-sensitive Dio, feed, listings, search, and Profile lifecycles; actor-namespaced saved feed data. Evidence: flutter analyze clean; mobile unit/widget suite 102/102; app_ui 33/33; pgTAP 83/83; API 31/31; Android 15 API 35 real-stack discovery/Profile journey passed; live local Profile passed. User deployed hosted migration/function; hosted smoke returned Prince with HTTPS avatar and no preview actors, X-Preview-Actor override returned 403 FORBIDDEN, and userId query returned 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Remaining platform gaps: release APK signing is intentionally unconfigured; iOS execution retains the existing Flutter log-reader blocker.

title: Expand dashboard into real preview destinations
description: Prince directly expanded the product beyond the assessment's former out-of-scope notices: Search becomes an autocomplete experience with recents and truthful property-detail boundaries; List becomes a paginated property catalog with property-specific cards; Notification becomes a real server-backed activity home beginning with likes on the current user's posts; Profile shows current-user details and a safely gated developer current-user switch. All destinations must preserve the existing Expert Listing identity, system light/dark behavior, native platform mechanics, accessibility, stable geometry, and honest loading/error/empty states. This direct instruction supersedes the old destination notices and roadmap gate; the canonical specification must be revised before implementation claims completion.
design: Reuse app_ui tokens and controls, FeedRepository/post DTOs where their contracts fit, and Riverpod/Riverbloc lifecycle ownership. Do not add a router, second state system, ORM, service locator, local database, decorative effects, fake data success, or a production identity override. Keep the social Feed presentation separate from a property-first ListingCard. Resolve all new backend reads through thin Hono routes and vetted security-definer database functions.
acceptance_criteria: Each bottom destination has genuine selected state and preserved destination state. Search provides real autocomplete, bounded persisted recents, deliberate quick actions only where useful, and an exact property-detail preview notice. List paginates property-only server data in a property-first card layout. Notifications are returned by Hono for the server-resolved current user and include likes on that user's posts without trusting a raw client user ID. Profile renders server-backed current-user details in system light/dark themes; current-user switching is debug-only, explicitly server-gated, request-scoped, and clears actor-sensitive state. Focused state/widget/API/database tests cover race, persistence, identity, and interaction promises; named-width visual checks remain explicit evidence.
notes: Owner decisions, 2026-09-05: keep recent searches behind the explicit SharedPreferences RecentSearchStore rather than adding HydratedBloc for five device-local strings. Replaced the raw dashboard IndexedStack with a feature-local persistent transition host while preserving destination state and custom navigation geometry. iOS switches immediately like a native tab bar; Android uses the 200ms AppMotion Material crossfade; reduced motion is immediate. Only incoming/outgoing pages remain onstage during Android motion; afterward inactive pages remain mounted but are Offstage with tickers, focus, interactions, and semantics disabled. Defer nested Navigators until destinations own real detail routes. Verification in the direnv Flutter 3.47.0 shell on macOS: full flutter analyze clean; full flutter test 91 passed; dashboard platform/state tests 2 passed; Android 15/API 35 real-stack discovery integration passed after the host change; git diff --check passed.

title: Cue create-post after feed readiness
description: Replace the rejected loading-time surface fade with a restrained one-shot affordance that begins only after the first visible feed data arrives.
design: FeedView passes readiness from state.posts.isNotEmpty. CreatePostPrompt owns a one-shot 1200ms outline opacity sequence composed from four AppMotion.slow intervals: 300ms ease in, a 600ms quiet peak, and 300ms ease out. Paint the border in the foreground over the existing pill; do not animate background, scale, translation, blur, gradient, or content.
acceptance_criteria: CreatePostPrompt keeps its stable subtleSurface and exact 56px geometry. Once the feed first transitions from no posts to visible posts, a thin semantic-brand outline appears and fades exactly once without moving content, replaying on refresh/filter changes, or running during initial loading. Reduced-motion users receive no animation. Activation and semantics remain unchanged, with focused timing and geometry coverage.
close_reason: Closed per owner direction (good enough, commit). Replaced the rejected loading-time surface fade with a one-shot foreground outline tied to real feed readiness: FeedView passes state.posts.isNotEmpty; CreatePostPrompt latches the first ready state, then animates a 1px semantic brand outline for 1200ms (300ms ease in, 600ms hold, 300ms ease out) while the subtleSurface, content, 56px geometry, activation, and semantics remain unchanged. Later refresh/filter state cannot replay it. MediaQuery disableAnimations skips it entirely. Evidence on macOS in direnv Flutter 3.47 shell: targeted flutter analyze clean; focused tests 2 passed for readiness timing, visible hold, no replay, stable geometry, and reduced motion; full mobile flutter analyze clean; full flutter test 75 passed; dart format clean; git diff --check clean. title: Engagement and heading controls miss 48px touch areas despite 48px semantics nodes
description: Probe-verified on Flutter 3.47: OverflowBox-sized controls (post_card heading author button, trailing overflow icon, engagement _Action rows) render a 48x48 semantics node but touch hit-testing is gated by each ancestor's size.contains, so taps only land within the parent's reserved band: 40px tall for the heading row and only 16px tall (48 wide) for the engagement actions. AppAvatar avoids this by reserving the 48px box in layout and pinning the 40px visual, which works beside a taller column but would shift sequential card content if applied to the heading or actions rows. Fixing the touch geometry requires a design decision about reserved space versus the measured Figma bands.
